v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Tibi soli peccávi, * Dómine, miserére mei.
text.en: Before thee only have I sinned, * O Lord, have mercy on me.

text.la: Convértere, Dómine, * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
text.en: Turn thee again, O Lord, * and be gracious unto thy servants.
O God, * thou hast multiplied thy mercy.

text.la: Fortitúdo mea * et laus mea Dóminus: et factus est mihi in salútem.
text.en: The Lord is my strength * and my praise, and he is become my salvation.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum qui sanat contrítos corde, et álligat contritiónes eórum.
text.en: Praise the Lord * who healeth the broken of heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Dómine, * puer meus iacet paralýticus in domo, et male torquétur: Amen dico tibi, ego véniam, et curábo eum.
text.en: Lord, * my servant lieth at home sick of the palsy, and is grieviously tormented. Amen, I say unto thee, I will come and heal him.

text.la: Deus, qui culpa offénderis, pæniténtia placáris: preces pópuli tui supplicántis propítius réspice; et flagélla tuæ iracúndiæ, quæ pro peccátis nostris merémur, avérte.
text.en: O God, whom sin doth justly move to anger, and at repentance doth turn again to forgive the same; mercifully regard the prayers of your people, and turn aside the scourges of thy wrath, which we deserve for our sins.

title.la: In Apparitione Beatæ Mariæ Virginis Immaculatæ
title.en: The Apparition of the Blessed Virgin Mary at Lourdes

text.la: Præclára salútis auróra, ex te, Virgo María, exívit sol iustítiæ, qui visitávit nos óriens ex alto.
text.en: Beautiful aurora of salvation, out of thee, O Virgin Mary, came forth the sun of justice who has visited us, the Orient from on high.

v.la: Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
v.en: Grace is poured into thy lips.

r.la: Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
r.en: Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

text.la: Deus, qui per immaculátam Vírginis Conceptiónem dignum Fílio tuo habitáculum præparásti: súpplices a te quǽsumus; ut, eiúsdem Vírginis Apparitiónem celebrántes, salútem mentis et córporis consequámur.
text.en: O God, who by the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin didst prepare a worthy dwelling place for thy Son, we humbly beseech thee; that we, who celebrate the appearance of the same Virgin, may obtain health of soul and body.
